# Sandforge

> Sandbox templates (an E2B Firecracker microVM and a devcontainer) with a trust envelope, a validator for schema and trust rules, runtime routing, and a live E2B boot that checks the envelope holds. CLI `sandforge`, MCP server `sandforge-mcp`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): What it does, every command and MCP tool, and what not to do.
- [README.md](README.md): Introduction, quick start and how it works.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Operating rules for Claude Code in this repository.

## Skills

- [template-validate](skills/template-validate/SKILL.md): Check templates against the schema and trust rules before a commit.
- [template-scaffold](skills/template-scaffold/SKILL.md): Add a template that starts from the strictest trust envelope.
- [sandbox-boot](skills/sandbox-boot/SKILL.md): Boot an e2b template in a live E2B microVM and read the probes.

## MCP tools and CLI

- [mcp/server.mjs](mcp/server.mjs): sandforge_validate, sandforge_dispatch, sandforge_list_templates, sandforge_get_template, sandforge_plan (none boots a sandbox).
- [bin/sandforge.mjs](bin/sandforge.mjs): list, show, validate, pick, plan, boot, recall.
- [lib/boot.mjs](lib/boot.mjs): How a template becomes Sandbox.create options and probes.

## Templates

- [templates/e2b-default/README.md](templates/e2b-default/README.md): E2B microVM, no egress; includes what the first live boot showed.
- [templates/devcontainer-default/README.md](templates/devcontainer-default/README.md): devcontainer for local dev and CI.
- [eval/schema/template.schema.json](eval/schema/template.schema.json): The template schema.

## Identity and memory

- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): Who Sandforge is, personality, hard boundaries.
- [identity/MEMORY.md](identity/MEMORY.md): Bootstrap context and the trust envelope invariants.
- [identity/LEARNINGS.md](identity/LEARNINGS.md): Corrections that became rules.
- [.claude/agents/trust-auditor.md](.claude/agents/trust-auditor.md): Read-only reviewer of trust changes.
- [.claude/agents/template-forger.md](.claude/agents/template-forger.md): Writes templates, never widens a trust envelope.

## Optional

- [dsip.json](dsip.json): The self-improvement contract (L2: a nightly loop proposes, a person lands).
- [eval/golden.json](eval/golden.json): Cases the validator, router and boot plan must keep passing.
